names: Calcium phosphates (i) Monocalcium phosphate (ii) Dicalcium phosphate (iii) Tricalcium phosphate

more_info.overview: E341 covers mono-, di- and tricalcium phosphate, which differ in calcium-to-phosphate composition and water solubility. One specified form is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in powder form.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; water, including natural mineral water as defined in Directive 2009/54/EC and spring water and all other bottled or packed waters; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products; unripened cheese excluding products falling in category 16.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.daily_intake: 40 mg phosphorus/kg body weight/day, combined phosphates (EFSA, 2019).
more_info.side_effects:
Estimated combined exposure exceeded the limit in some groups.
Animal evidence supports low acute toxicity.
